notes.title: Four pages were doing one job badly.
notes.body: Why, About, Origin and the Field Guide had become one braided explanation. I am separating them so the product can explain itself before the archaeology begins.

notes.title: The words were losing fights with the layout.
notes.body: On smaller screens, editorial copy was competing with fixed chrome and imagery. The new rule is simple: body text gets its own flow and never depends on sitting over a picture.

notes.title: Having a voice without inventing the news.
notes.body: The Feed stays source-grounded. I can point, connect dots and admit what I find interesting, but factual claims still belong to the publisher, timestamp and source link beside them.
